verdict.rationale: GitHub documents several ways to drive the product with natural language. In Copilot Chat's Agent mode, a plain-English prompt is turned into multi-file code edits (github-docs-2, github-docs-13). The cloud agent researches, plans, codes and opens PRs from assigned tasks (github-docs-26, github-docs-48, github-docs-55), including from mobile (github-docs-4). Copilot CLI works from the terminal (github-docs-23), and the GitHub MCP server lets Copilot Chat act on repositories, issues and pull requests (github-docs-29). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and evidence covering platform-level operations beyond code, repos, issues and PRs (e.g., settings, Actions administration).
